text:
maria: :rotating_light: p99 spike hitting multiple regions, started ~09:04 UTC. Customers reporting streaming stalls and slow completions. Noticing router LB misrouting to a small hot set of backends.
samir: paging now. i'm oncall, will collect traces. assigning to @anika for LB config check. :phone:
incident-bot: Incident 2025-03-15-2245 created. Severity: Sev2. Channels: #incidents, #eng-runtime, #eng-infra. Pager escalated to samir.
anika: saw a config change landed at 09:02 by deploy-bot (rollout id: r-8421). looks like new routing policy weight calc introduced an edge case where hot partitions get sticky. pulling diffs now.
maria: here's what telemetry shows: p95 up 30%, p99 up 4x in us-west and eu-west. streaming stalls ~15-30s for affected requests. tail latencies concentrated on requests hitting shard IDs with high qps.
luke: CS reports 3 customers experiencing request drops in streaming sessions (voice transcripts), one customer escalated to CSM. please prioritize mitigation.
samir: runbook step 1 -> confirm hitset. logs show repeated 502/timeout downstream from backends A-C. routing table shows >70% of routed requests to 3 pods in pool-7.
anika: rolling back the routing policy change now to last-known-good. command:
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/ingress-router router=image:v1.8.3 --namespace=infra
# or revert config map
kubectl apply -f /configs/router-policy-gkg.yaml
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started (id: rb-2504). Estimated 90s to converge.
maria: good. hotfix idea: temporarily enable eager fallback to idle pool to redistribute hotkeys. will toggle in 60s if rollback not reducing tail.
samir: checking traces in jaeger: requests hitting the hot pods have 10-20x queueing time. KV cache miss rates are elevated for these shards (cache growing due to skew).
luke: customer impact summary for CS: approx 0.2% of total requests, but concentrated on streaming flows for language customers in us-west/eu-west. potential SLA blips for those customers.
anika: rollback complete. router conf hash changed back at 09:06. see new routing table: weights redistributed across pool-2..pool-12. monitoring convergence.
samir: metrics updating — p95 trending back down, p99 still elevated but dropping. starting mitigation window and watch for 10m.
maria: enabling eager fallback now to drain hot pods faster:
```json
{"fallback": "enable_eager", "threshold_ms": 2000}
```
anika: eager fallback applied. also draining the three hot pods from pool-7 to force rebalancing.
samir: live tail shows streaming ack latency dropping from 28s -> 6s within 90s of rollback+fallback. p99 now ~1.3s above baseline (was +4s). continue monitoring.
luke: preparing customer message: short ack + ETA for full recovery (~15-30min). cc: CSMs.
maria: creating post-incident follow-up items: 1) fix weight calc to avoid hotness amplification, 2) add alert for >50% routing to <5 backends for a shard, 3) KV cache eviction tuning for skewed shards, 4) test scenario in chaos lab.
anika: adding an emergency unit test to CI to catch sticky-weight regressions and a guarded rollout flag for new policy.
samir: marking incident as under control at 09:12 UTC. moving to monitoring. will keep it open until 10:00 UTC for confirmation.
incident-bot: Incident 2025-03-15-2245 status: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Pager cleared for samir.
luke: customer note: "We saw intermittent streaming stalls earlier today; the team is investigating and rolling mitigations. We will follow up with a full incident summary." sending now.
maria: postmortem owners: maria (lead), anika (infra), samir (sre). target: publish within 72 hours. include timeline, root cause (policy weight calc + hot key amplification), mitigation steps, and customer impact table.
samir: final check: any lingering errors in eu-west? small residuals but within SLOs. closing live page at 09:16 UTC unless someone objects.
anika: nbd, looks stable here.
luke: thanks all. great triage. :tada:
